phy-sol-01-c1.text: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Energy Efficiency and Renewable Energy (2003). The History of Solar. U.S. Department of Energy.
phy-sol-01-c1.quote: The Vanguard I space satellite used a small (less than one watt) array to power its radios.
phy-sol-01-c1.claim: Within four years, Vanguard 1 carried PV cells into orbit, and the satellite industry has powered itself with them ever since.
